name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
description: One of the world's largest and finest art museums with extensive collections spanning 5,000 years.
review: The Met has been making family guides since the late 1990's. The guides are available online and have great interactive materials for preschool, and early elementary learners, about art and culture. Their online tour is a series of youtube videos that work like virtual reality experiences, but for you Ipad or smartphone. I do not personally like this method compared to other tour softwares because its tedious to have to go from video to video.

name: The British Museum
description: A museum of human history and culture with over 8 million objects from around the world.
review: The British Museum offers a comprehensive overview of human history and culture. Its virtual tour is well-organized, allowing users to explore different sections of the museum easily. They do a very good job of creating educational materials using a wide variety of mediums from videos, podcasts, to structured activities.

name: The American Museum of Natural History
description: A major museum featuring exhibits on human cultures, the natural world, and space exploration.
review: The American Museum of Natural History provides an engaging virtual tour experience. The 3D tour allows users to explore the museum's vast exhibits, from dinosaur fossils to space displays. The educational resources available online are top-notch, making it a great destination for learners of all ages.

name: The Louvre
description: The world's most visited museum, home to the Mona Lisa and thousands of masterpieces.
review: The Louvre offers an exceptional virtual tour experience, allowing users to launch into different collections of art and artifacts. The online tours are interactive with different engaging icons providing detailed information about different artifacts. The museum's educational resources are catered more for in person tourists. However, MAH users can take advantage of the Visitor Trails to add to their virtual trip around the museum.

name: The National WWII Museum
description: A comprehensive museum dedicated to World War II history with interactive exhibits.
review: The National WWII Museum offers a detailed look into the events of World War II. While it lacks a 3D tour, some of their podcasts provide rich narratives that enhance the virtual experience. The museum's commitment to education is evident in its well-curated classroom guides and other online resources.

name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
description: A leading modern and contemporary art museum with works from the late 19th century to present.
review: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) provides a rich virtual experience with its extensive collection of modern and contemporary art. The 3D tour allows users to navigate through the galleries and appreciate the artworks up close with clarity. The audio guides offer insightful commentary, making it a valuable resource for art enthusiasts and students alike. The Teaching Resources section is particularly helpful for educators looking to incorporate art into their curriculum, and includes lessons in spanish.

name: The Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
description: One of the world's preeminent museums of natural history with over 145 million specimens.
review: The Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History offers a captivating virtual tour experience, showcasing its vast collection of specimens and exhibits. The 3D tour was coded for the museum which allows users to explore the museum's halls with an integrated map for easy navigation. While the complete museum audio tour is not available for free, the museum provides a few specific exhibits have audio tours, which are included it this MAH profile. They have great resources for educators and students, making it a valuable tool for learning about natural history.

name: The Vatican Museums
description: A vast collection of art and antiquities from the Roman Empire to the present day.
review: This is a nice way to bring a little slice of Italy into your day. The Vatican Museum has several stand-alone room tours that are in a 360 view. Given its status as a historic site for tourists most educational offerings are not in an online format. However that does not take away from the beauty of the architecture you can find online.

name: The Science Museum
description: An interactive science museum with exhibits covering technology, space, and natural sciences.
review: The Science Museum in London offers an engaging virtual tour experience, allowing visitors to explore its diverse exhibits from the comfort of their homes. The 3D tour is well-designed, providing an interactive way to learn about science and technology. The audio guides can be found on the offical museum app, and enhance the experience with informative commentary, making it a great resource for students and educators alike.

name: The Grand Egyptian Museum
description: Home to the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts including mummies and treasures.
review: The Grand Egyptian Museum offers a limited, but stunning, virtual tour experience, allowing visitors to explore some of its collection of ancient artifacts from the comfort of their homes. While the audio tour is not available for free, the museum's website offers a wealth of information and resources for those interested in learning more about ancient Egyptian history.

name: The National Museum of the American Indian
description: Built in 1989, the museum strives to advance knowledge and understanding of Native culture through partnership with Native people and others.
review: The online resources of Native history and culture provided by this museum are top tier. Their Native 360 programs are organized and contain a huge amount of information curated for a variety of topics. I visited this museum in person once, and it was unforgettable. Their online presence creates meaningful and authentic experiences.

name: The National Civil War Museum
description: Dedicated to preserving and interpreting the American Civil War, featuring extensive exhibits and artifacts.
review: The National Civil War Museum offers an exceptional virtual experience, allowing history enthusiasts to explore its extensive collection from anywhere in the world. The 3D tour is immersive, and the audio guides is accessible via Youtube and provides valuable insights into the exhibits and artifacts, making it a must-visit for anyone interested in American history.

name: The National Museum of African American History and Culture
description: The museum is dedicated to the documentation of African American life, history, and culture.
review: The National Museum of African American History and Culture offers a profound virtual experience using their North Star Program. It allows visitors to explore its rich collection of artifacts and exhibitions through The Searchable Museum app and website. Their virtual presence leans into the African American experience, making it a must-visit for anyone interested in history and culture.
